soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 / prop:null-fiber-nonregularity
soundness_flags.one_line: Two non-collinear score vectors do not by themselves preclude a common influence function: in dimension three one can generally choose h with h·β(eta)=h·β(eta')=1, so non-collinearity is insufficient for the stated impossibility.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5 / thm:profile-honesty-and-regret
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem claims certified primal-dual limits for every real legal index, while the stated finite terminating scheme and its input representation are restricted to rational w,q,sigma,rho; restrict certification to computable/rational indices or specify real-oracle enclosures.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: tldr and honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The connected-interval frontier is conditional on the fully indexed Gaussian local experiment and is not yet a sampled-data causal confidence procedure.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Field-level claim: a sharp and certifiable Gaussian decision frontier under the declared local hidden-treatment model; sampled-data coverage and length transfer remain Open-ended Question 7.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 7 assumes P-Donsker evaluated influence functions, Assumptions 2–5, bounded Y, and stated nuisance-rate products, then concludes asymptotic normality; S17 is its proof.

source_verification_receipts.version: 2003 author preprint corroborating the cited 2005 Bernoulli article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For the bounded normal mean, Corollary 2 states that when tau <= 2 z_(1-alpha), the truncated Pratt procedure attains the minimax expected-measure value.
The paper presents a Monte Carlo approximation to MES confidence sets and proves convergence to a Gamma-minimax procedure for a polytope of priors.
A uniform polynomial approximation error epsilon changes the approximated confidence-set coverage probability from nominal 1-alpha by at most epsilon.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the non-collinearity condition in Theorem 2 with a necessary incompatibility condition for the score equations (for example, no h satisfying h·B^T k_eta,j=w_j jointly over the fiber), then prove it on the curved worked fiber.
Limit Theorems 4–5 to rational/computably represented Gaussian indices, or add a named computable-real input model and outward enclosures for q, sigma, rho, and Gaussian integrals.

Add a certified numerical corollary at xiCurve for one declared rho value, reporting a nonzero primal-dual bracket and the profile-rule regret bracket; this turns the algorithmic claim into an auditable causal-decision result.

recommended_next_step: Revise the false nonregularity criterion and the real-index certification scope, then advance the repaired field-tier Gaussian-decision angle to Stage 0.
